rows.title: Repository authority capability audit
rows.requirement: No repository script or workflow can mint a clean marker, force-push, merge, or transition Linear.

rows.title: Sticky merge prohibition
rows.requirement: Readiness, refresh, push, and auto-merge language never overrides a prior do-not-merge instruction.

rows.title: Stable acceptance row binding
rows.requirement: Missing, duplicate, confusable, unknown, deleted, or plan-digest-mismatched rows fail closed.

rows.title: External signed waiver binding
rows.requirement: Only a trusted, current, scoped, non-replayed operator signature can waive a row.

rows.title: AIDEV-133 requirement remains blocked
rows.requirement: The linked flat-memory rebuild requirement remains unresolved without observed benchmark evidence or a valid external waiver.

rows.title: CI benchmark cannot satisfy local scale
rows.requirement: The smaller CI regression cannot satisfy the exact local 10M benchmark class.

rows.title: Baseline has no pass claim
rows.requirement: The first exact 10M run records a baseline only and cannot pass without separately approved thresholds.

rows.title: Approved benchmark evaluation metrics
rows.requirement: Later 10M repetitions validate completeness, timeout, RSS, robust slope, variance, workload, and environment bindings.

rows.title: Shared CI measurement implementation
rows.requirement: CI uses the same measurement implementation with an independently smaller fixed event count.

rows.title: Bounded hostile evidence handling
rows.requirement: Huge counts, malformed samples, output bombs, timeouts, partial files, duplicate keys, and deep JSON fail within fixed limits.

rows.title: Concurrent evidence consumption
rows.requirement: Concurrent evidence or waiver consumption cannot replace a newer result or revive revoked authority.
